_comment: Decides which clio.mcp.e2e fixtures a pull request has to run on TeamCity (Team_Atf_ClioMcpE2eTests).
Consumed by .github/scripts/Select-McpE2eTestFilter.ps1 from .github/workflows/teamcity-mcp-e2e.yml;
guarded by clio.tests/McpE2eSelectionCoverageTests.cs. Rules, in order, per changed file:
1. not under relevantPaths            -> ignored (did not trigger the workflow either)
2. matches fullRunPaths               -> the whole suite runs (shared infrastructure)
3. clio.mcp.e2e/<Fixture>.cs          -> that fixture
4. explicitMappings                   -> the listed fixtures
5. clio/Command/McpServer/Tools/**/X.cs -> every fixture whose source names a class declared in X.cs,
a tool-name literal declared in X.cs, or is named X*E2ETests;
zero matches -> the whole suite runs
6. other clio/**/*.cs                 -> the files under clio/ that name a type declared in it are its
consumers (registrationFiles do not count). All consumers are
tool files -> the union of rule 5 over them; any consumer
elsewhere, or none at all (DI/reflection) -> the whole suite runs
7. anything else                      -> the whole suite runs
A subset larger than maxSubsetFixtures also becomes a full run (command-line length; the NUnit
adapter's 2000-test limit for non-category filters is far above this suite's size, revisit if it grows).
A subset whose fixtures have no McpE2E.Sandbox test becomes mode 'none': nothing is queued, because
the NoEnvironment tier runs on GitHub-hosted runners (.github/workflows/build.yml, job
mcp-e2e-noenvironment) and pull-request runs on TeamCity exclude it. The TeamCity step's default
filter is baseFilter; a full pull-request run sends baseFilter plus TestCategory!=McpE2E.NoEnvironment.
_fullRunOnlyFixtures: Fixtures that exercise server-level behaviour (startup, shutdown, worker processes, HTTP routing,
progress relay) rather than one MCP tool. Their code lives entirely under fullRunPaths, so they run
in every full run and no tool file can select them. clio.tests/McpE2eSelectionCoverageTests.cs
accepts them as reachable only because they are listed here; keep the list to fixtures of that kind.
